title: MAnimals
description: The wilderness just got wilder! MAnimals introduces brand new animals with unique behaviors. Tame them, feed them, and let them accompany you on your greatest adventures!
body:
# 🐾 MAnimals

MAnimals is a mod that adds brand new animals to your Minecraft world! 
Encounter them in the wild, earn their trust, tame them, and make them 
your loyal companions on every adventure.

## ✨ Features
-  Tame and feed unique animals
-  Each animal has its own behavior
-  Explore the world with your companions by your side

## 🐻 Animals
| Animal     | Status       |
|------------|--------------|
| Bear       | ✅ Available |
| Lemur      | ✅ Available |
| Chameleon  | ✅ Available |

##  Bugs & Suggestions
Found a bug or have an idea? 
Feel free to leave a comment, all feedback is welcome!
